commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' 4 - 1 Goal! Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 4:1.
90+2' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Liverpool.

90+1' What a great effort! Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
90+1' The referee awards a corner and Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) goes over to take it.
90+1' Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' It will be a substitution. Alex Murphy (Newcastle Utd) is ready to enter the pitch as Lewis Hall walks off.
89' Corner kick. Liverpool will have an opportunity.
89' It is time for a substitution. Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) is on for Lewis Hall.
89' Joe Willock will be replaced by Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd).
89' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) replaces Lewis Hall.
87' The referee signals a substitution. Wataru Endo (Liverpool) is brought on as a substitute for Florian Wirtz.
86' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) receives a yellow card from the referee for shouting at the linesman.
84' The substitution has been made. William Osula (Newcastle Utd) has replaced Kieran Trippier.
84' Arne Slot has decided to substitute Hugo Ekitike and he is replaced by Curtis Jones (Liverpool).
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) comes onto the pitch so that Mohamed Salah can be given a rest.
82' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd).
80' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) launches a cross from the corner, but Alisson is alert to thwart the effort.

80' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Newcastle will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

78' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
78' Some patient build-up play from Newcastle as they look to unlock the defence.
75' Liverpool hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
73' That will be all from Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nick Woltemade.
73' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd) replacing Harvey Barnes.
73' Here comes a substitution. Alex Murphy is brought on as a substitute for Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd).

69' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball towards goal and it goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
67' 3 - 1 Goal! Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 3:1.
67' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alisson intercepts the ball.
65' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
63' Liverpool hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
60' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Alisson easily deals with the threat.
59' Caution goes to Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool).
56' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Alisson.
55' Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd) is about to take a goal kick.
52' Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

51' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
49' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
47' Some neat passing and movement from Liverpool as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
46' The whistle blows and Simon Hooper starts the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+4' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar.
45+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle Utd) was quite harsh and Simon Hooper didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+1' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
43' 2 - 1 Goal! Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:1.
43' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Alisson has no trouble gathering it.
41' 1 - 1 Goal! Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
40' Flag up against Mohamed Salah (Liverpool). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
38' The ball is out of play. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner.
36' 0 - 1 Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) picks up the ball on the edge of the penalty box and produces a moment of magic with a brilliant shot that goes into the left side of the goal!
34' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Hugo Ekitike, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared.
34' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempts to feed Hugo Ekitike with a chip pass, but Nick Pope reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
33' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
33' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Nick Pope.
32' The linesman signals a throw-in for Liverpool.
30' Simon Hooper blows the whistle, Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) is penalised for a foul. Newcastle will take a free kick near the side line.
27' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
27' There's an opportunity for Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
26' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
26' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) fires a brilliant shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rattles the right post! It could have been a superb goal.

25' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Newcastle have a free kick from a promising distance.
24' Simon Hooper blows his whistle as Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
23' Some great controlled play and passing from Liverpool. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
21' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner.
20' The resulting corner from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
20' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Newcastle.
20' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

17' That didn't go as planned! Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Nick Pope, who easily kept it out.
17' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
14' Liverpool are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
12' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) has tested the patience of referee Simon Hooper and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
9' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
7' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
6' The resulting set piece from Newcastle is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
6' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
5' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
3' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
2' Good work from Newcastle as they win a corner.
2' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play. Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Newcastle will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Simon Hooper.
